whatsNew.pointAppearance: Customize click and drag point colors and size in Settings. Area boxes use the same colors.
whatsNew.dragPosition: Dragging now keeps the released position for interactions that support it.
whatsNew.compactControls: Preview controls adapt to smaller panels, including when the character list is open.
whatsNew.settingsScrolling: Settings stays within the window, with scrolling content and a fixed header and footer.
whatsNew.supporterActivation: Activate supporter access in Settings with your AFDIAN order number or Ko-fi activation code.
whatsNew.datingControls: Choose a dating pose, reset interactions, and show or hide interaction points and areas.
whatsNew.assetLoadingFix: Fixed character asset filenames that prevented some previews from loading.
whatsNew.groupCameraFix: Fixed grouped previews sometimes ignoring zoom and movement until the camera was fitted.
whatsNew.minigames: Preview Slap Slap Slop characters with tap, hold, drag, and Fever interactions.
whatsNew.copyConfirmation: Added confirmation when copying your ID.
whatsNew.cutsceneVisibilityFix: Fixed cutscene parts remaining visible after their cuts ended.
whatsNew.datingAssetsFix: Fixed missing assets for Aquila's multipart dating preview.
whatsNew.whatsNewFix: Fixed What's New appearing behind the toolbar.
whatsNew.syncGroups: Assign previews to the same numbered group to zoom, move, and control playback together.
whatsNew.playbackFixes: Fixed pausing and restarting previews from the toolbar.
whatsNew.datingFixes: Fixed dating interactions starting on an empty animation and added support for dating scenes with multiple parts.
whatsNew.characters: Updated character data and improved drag-and-drop support.
whatsNew.interface: Redesigned settings, character list, history, and logs.
whatsNew.layers: Choose skins and show or hide individual layers.
whatsNew.modManager: Enable or disable mods from the preview when connected to BD2ModManager.
whatsNew.cutscenes: Play supported cutscenes using timing from the game.
whatsNew.title: What's New
whatsNew.feedback: Have feedback or ideas? Share them on GitHub.
whatsNew.grid: Preview multiple mods side by side. Drag to rearrange them and resize each preview.
whatsNew.controls: Control all previews together or choose animations separately.
whatsNew.folders: Open multiple folders at once and reopen previews from recent folders.
whatsNew.themes: Added themes and translated character names.
whatsNew.dating: Added dating interactions, including clicking, dragging, and holding.
